formattedAddress: No. 1號, Lane 50, Xining S Rd, Wanshou Village, Wanhua District, Taipei City, Taiwan 108

text.text:
Little nice bar and coffee place with a relaxed roof top terrace.
Drinks (alkoholisches snd iced coffee) and service are very good.
We didn’t like to have a lot of smokers of cigarettes and cigars around us. It’s bothering a lot donee didn’t want to hang here longer and wouldn’t come back for that reason.
The terrace in the roof is nice though, in the middle of the city yet in front of a parking garage.
